entities.summary: Kojo Adu Asare is a Ghanaian politician and a former member of parliament for the Adenta constituency in the Greater Accra Region of Ghana. Asare won the Adenta parliamentary seat in the 2008 general election on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress, defeating incumbent Kwadjo Opare-Hammond. The results show he polled 20,230 votes to Opare-Hammond’s 16,646.
